notes.title: Translation Update
notes.notes:
This update introduces Russian and German translations, includes balance changes, and adds several quality of life improvements.

AdditionsAdded German translationAdded Russian translation (thanks NikSynaly)Added icon for Exile next to graveyard icon (only shows when you have exiled creatures)Added "Quick Remove" button for lacrima (backpack icon that appears when clicking on an equipped lacrima)Added "Quick Equip" option when clicking on empty card slotsAdded "Clear Cards" button in inventory to quickly remove lacrima from all cardsAdded confirmation button for lacrima/blessing/card rewardsAdded new option to enable/disable confirmations (Options > General)Added new effect for card rewards (similar to lacrima rewards)Added card notificiation for whenever a status effect runs out or gets removedAdded support for ultrawidescreen, 16:10, 4:3, and other resolutions
Card info is now shown when targeting a card with a spell
Gameplay AdjustmentsAdjusted boss fights: Chapter 1 and 2 boss fights always have 3 lanes, chapter 3 boss fight always has 5 lanes (thanks PersistentDreamer)Valefar: Changed "Steal Lacrima" to "Fracture"Amdusias: Removed "Magic Ward" from Chapter 1Demons now face up when spawned on enemy side during player's turn (i.e. after casting a spell)
Exhumed enemies no longer get revealed when they are exhumed during the attack phase (thanks Qwerty)Curses/Blessings can no longer get overcharged outside of combat (thanks Qwerty)Parasite now always starts with 2 on success; each success adds another 2Generated enemies no longer receive Heal if they already have Reinforced Shield / Magic WardGravedigger: Added 1 spell with Exhume to deck from the start (thanks Kool8987)Turned GlassCannon into a modifier (= purple lacrima)Reworked Deathblow: Deals damage equal to Bleed stacks and removes Bleed. Activation success: If 5 or more Bleed stacks got removed, destroy non-boss creature.TargetAll/Enemies/Allies effects now reduce lacrima values by 50% (thanks Arifmeticus)
UI/UX AdjustmentsDeckbound, Healingbound, Discardbound, and Despairbound now show relevant numbers in descriptionsRemoved "Mugged" triggerAdded Button decorations to small "1-space" buttons (i.e. inventory arrows)Pressing left on lacrima in satchel always goes to cards (same for Altar of Tears)
Description for the "End turn" button is now always shown during first fight and whole first runRest sequence now fades in/out instead of panning up/down (reduces motion sickness)Made shop music a bit quieter (thanks Pablo Murphy)
FixesFixed softlock when playing a creature on another creature mid-chain reaction (thanks Micha, Qwerty)Fixed rare bug where a trigger would incorrectly turn into a modifier in Altar of Tears (thanks Qwerty)Fixed preview bug in Altar of Tears when moving active lacrima to inventory (thanks BrandMChaos)Fixed issue where active map node circle disappeared when clicking "Options" during Rest (thanks Qwerty)Fixed "Provoked" not triggering on immune bosses for offence lacrima actions (thanks Qwerty)Fixed despair icons (on cards in hand) not updating correctly when despair is reduced (thanks Qwerty)Fixed "Demon" not spawning correctly when placing a creature (thanks Qwerty)Fixed lacrima from Automaton not returning when Recycle was fractured (thanks Qwerty)Fixed lacrima activation ring stuck to cards without animationFixed creature moving lanes during chain reactions returning incorrectly with 0 HPFixed Turn Passed: Exodus situation where fight didn't properly endFixed issue with status effects not appearing correctly in battle log
Thanks for playing Faith in Despair.

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
This update focuses on bug fixes before adding more content.


 Bite and the trigger Bitten now only appear when playing the Bloodsucker deck
 Added active map node indicator
 Added an error message when you press Redraw but you don't have enough gold (thanks Qwerty)
 Added proper explanation for cooldown (thanks Qwerty)
 Allow checking blessings/curses/map/inventory during fight/treasure rewards (thanks DoniaCometa)
 You can now click on your deck in the lower left corner to open your inventory (not during fights)
 You can now quit and continue the game while viewing fight/treasure rewards
 Fixed rendering issue on start screen when playing the game in a browser on a mobile phone
 Fixed F8 feedback form not submitting anymore
 Fixed bug where RandomBuff cast by an enemy card would give the same status effect within a turn (thanks Qwerty)
 Fixed problem in options menu where you were able to open several option submenus if you clicked fast enough (thanks DoniaCometa)
 Fixed a bug where flipping pages in inventory could cause slots to affect multiple cards (thanks DoniaCometa)
 Fixed issue while dragging lacrima in inventory and turning pages at the same time (thanks DoniaCometa)
 Fixed an issue where replacing a creature on a lane would kill the existing creature (i.e. due to a curse) and then the new creature would not be placed on the lane (thanks Qwerty)

Thanks for playing Faith in Despair.

notes.title: Circles of Hell - Version 0.1.15
notes.notes:
Version 0.1.15 introduces Circles of Hell, which are difficulty adjustments. More of them will be added in the future. With this change, the default game has been made slightly easier.


 Added Circles of Hell (selection appears after the first run)
 No more starter curse by default
 Added fixed starter blessing by default ("Meditation")
 No more unlimited curses by default, each new curse will replace the old one
 Increased default max despair to 67
 Reduced redraw price from 50 to 10 (thanks Syndel)
 Buffed starter deck cards (one Spell with Heal has a value of 10 now)
 Added 5 missing tooltips for triggers (thanks Syndel and tmachine)
 Card details are now shown for cards in hand as well (thanks Syndel)
 Right-click doesn't close end screen anymore (thanks NowOnTest)
 "On Attack" now triggers before physical damage is dealt (thanks Syndel)
 New cards are now drawn after enemy cards are revealed (to make OnShuffleDeck work after revealing cards) (thanks Syndel)
 Blessings selection screen now also shows card details on hover
 Added trigger "On Discard Card" (thanks Syndel)
 To address an issue with reloading a save file, I've now added a global exception handling (thanks NowOnTest)
 Fixed issue where card info was still displayed after leaving the end screen (thanks NowOnTest)
 Fixed calculation error with Burn on card with Magic Ward
 Fixed issue where sometimes after a fight you couldn't view blessings/curses (thanks Syndel)
 Fixed shops letting you sell more than one card if you didn't sell a card in previous shops (thanks Syndel)
 Fixed card arrow sometimes appearing misplaced


Thank you for playing Faith in Despair.

notes.title: Version 0.1.14 - Deckbuilder Fest
notes.notes:
This patch includes small but relevant bug fixes.


 ​GlassCannon now reduces max HP by 75%, instead of current HP (thanks Syndel).
 Redraw button glows now when you have fewer creatures in hand than total enemies (and if you have enough money).
 Rearranged shop layout
 Open inventory with square (playstation controller) or x (xbox controller) or Space (keyboard)
 You can now hover over cards on end screen
 Lacrima rewards will now avoid offering duplicates
 Changed "Immune to Physical Damage" to "Reinforced Shield" (blocks 90% of physical damage)
 Changed "Immune to Magic Damage" to "Magic Ward" (blocks 90% of magic damage)
 Fixed lacrima description being visible when flipping through inventory pages
 Fixed issue where "OnEnemyDeath" would trigger endlessly
 Fixed bug in webgl build that showed "select an event"  when closing blessings/curse mid-fight
 Fixed JS bug in webgl build due to fullscreen permissions (also added fullscreen button in lower right)
 Fixed description not updating when getting rid of Mud status
 Fixed issue where sometimes cards could have negative HP

​Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Version 0.1.12 - Art Update
notes.notes:
Version 0.1.12 is live! Here's the list of changes:


 Fixed issue where Exhume would try to draw cards out of empty graveyards and spend too much time doing so.
 Made sure to exclude Levitation from AddRandomBuff.
 Collection now only includes the correct lacrima
 Overhauled game over screen, which now includes a "defeated by" card
 Changed "Discard Random Card" to "Discard Card" (still does the same)
 Changed OnDamageReceived to OnDamageTaken
 New card design with images by Odilon Redon
 New lacrima design
 Added L1/R1 to change pages in inventory
 Fixed bug where you could drag a lacrima outside of inventory
 Hovering over cards now scales them up a bit
 Winning a run now correctly stops the music
 Added new lane textures (instead of the symbol)
 Steam Deck improvements


Make sure to join the Discord: https://discord.gg/nZy3KrCrzr


Thank you for playing!

notes.title: Version V0.1.11 - Balance Update
notes.notes:
Version V0.1.11 is out!


Evened out level distribution on map fragments
Changed enemy HP/ATK scaling in chapter 2 and chapter 3
Removed dozens of triggers, actions and modifiers that were more than 3 or 4 words (some exceptions are still there)
Disabled "Levitation" from appearing in shops, rewards and enemies
Removed some blessings (more will be added again later)
Fixed "On Visit Shop" triggering every time you visited the same shop (thanks Auri)


Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Version 0.1.10 - Metastatistics + Collection
notes.notes:
Version 0.1.10 is live:


 Added metastatistics
 Added "Collection" to splash screen
 Clicking on shop/sacrifice/study is allowed again in case you accidentally leave (thanks Carni)
 Fixed issues with music (clicking noise, random background noise)
 Fixed issue where tooltop was left on screen after fight ended (thanks Auri)
 Improved end screen for decks of sizes between 36 and 45 (thanks VoidSeeker)
 Fixed issue when picking up lacrima in inventory and then exiting inventory with ESC
 Fixed issue where you could quickly play spells multiple times, causing cards to disappear from deck like a ghost card, only appearing face down randomly


Join the Discord to share your feedback: https://discord.com/invite/nZy3KrCrzr

Thanks for playing!
